Girafarig

Normal Psychic

Johto · Generation 2

Girafarig is a Normal/Psychic-type Long Neck Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 41.5 kg. It evolves into Farigiraf. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (90), with a base stat total of 455.
